description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Notice under Section 10 (3) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 2009 (Amended) Issuance of Certificate of Exemption
reasoning: The gazette content is a legal/regulatory notice issued by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under the specific authority of Section 10(3) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act. Its primary function is to formally publish the issuance of Certificates of Exemption from licensing requirements, which is a regulatory action. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or fit any other specialized category like Land, Commercial, or Elections. It is a statutory instrument published in the government notifications section.
